plumbing.label: Plumbing
plumbing.estimate: R850 - R12,500 depending on the job. Burst pipes and blocked drains start at R850, geyser replacements at R4,500, and full bathroom renovations from R35,000.
plumbing.lead: Standard plumbing jobs can usually be booked within 48 hours.

electrical.label: Electrical
electrical.estimate: R650 - R18,000 depending on the job. Fault finding starts at R650, DB board upgrades at R4,800, and solar backup systems from R18,000.
electrical.lead: Standard electrical jobs can usually be booked within 3 working days.

emergency.label: 24/7 Emergency
emergency.estimate: R950 call-out fee plus parts. The fee is confirmed with you on the phone before the van leaves, and the labour for the first hour is included.
emergency.lead: Our closest team reaches most of our service area within 60 minutes, day or night.

maintenance.label: Maintenance Plan
maintenance.estimate: R950 per year for one trade check, R1,650 per year for the full home check with a written condition report.
maintenance.lead: Maintenance visits are scheduled 7 to 10 days ahead, and members jump the queue on emergencies.

other.label: your request
other.estimate: Confirmed by phone. A technician will call you back with a fixed quote once they understand the job.
other.lead: We call back within 15 minutes during office hours.
